name: CASTLE (Cyber Agents for Security Testing and Learning Environments) - MATRIX Release
organization: DARPA (Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency)/ A2 Labs
description: An open source framework for training cyber agents built from the original TTCP CAGE Challenege 2. Formerly known as the Multi-Agent Trining Exerciser (MATrEx), released as MATRIX. Built in connection with the DARPA CASTLE Effort.
